title: Design System: Douglas Hill Consulting Studio

display.purpose: Primary hero statement (max-width 14.5ch) paired with one italic Instrument Serif focal word.

headline.purpose: Chapter-opening h2 headings across both Deep Velvet Night and Warm Raw Silk sections.

editorial-accent.purpose: Single italic focal noun/phrase inside Display and Section Headlines, plus roman impact numerals.

title.purpose: Capability bento titles, enterprise case-study headlines, and engagement track headers.

body.purpose: Long-form architectural narrative and case-study summaries (48ch–58ch measure).

label.purpose: Pill buttons, discipline switcher tabs, stack tags, and form field hints.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Default resting elevation for Pure Silk bento and FAQ cards.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for interactive Silk cards.

shadows.name: shadow-glow
shadows.purpose: Warm coral directional glow beneath primary conversion CTAs.

shadows.name: shadow-stage
shadows.purpose: Deep structural shadow grounding the 3D Continuum dock and dark-glass form card.

motion.name: ease-fluid
motion.purpose: Standard smooth deceleration for color, border, opacity, and drawer transitions.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Buoyant tactile response for button hover lifts and icon nudges.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Card elevation and header pill condensation transitions.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered section entrance choreography when motion is permitted.

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.42rem; max-width: 22rem; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-label { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-on-night, #f7f4ef); } .ds-input { min-height: 3.1rem; padding: 0.78rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--r-control, 0.95rem); border: 1px solid var(--c-line-dark, rgba(247, 244, 239, 0.1)); background: var(--c-input-bg, rgba(11, 12, 20, 0.65)); color: var(--c-on-night, #f7f4ef); font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--c-on-night-3, #8a91ab); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--c-line-dark-strong, rgba(247, 244, 239, 0.22)); background: var(--c-input-bg-hover, rgba(11, 12, 20, 0.82)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--c-coral, #ff6b4a); background: var(--c-input-bg-focus, rgba(11, 12, 20, 0.92)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-focus-ring-coral, rgba(255, 107, 74, 0.24)); }

narrative.overview:
Douglas Hill Consulting Studio balances calm principal-architect authority with kinetic architectural craft. Rather than presenting enterprise work as a rigid spreadsheet or a generic SaaS feature grid, the interface alternates deliberately between sculptural Deep Velvet Night stages (#0b0c14) and breathable Warm Raw Silk editorial canvases (#f6f3ee). Every interactive artifact — from the four-mode iridescent continuum sculpture to outcome-led case filtering — demonstrates senior fluency across custom web applications, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI intelligence, and cloud governance without swagger or clutter.

Typography and proportion carry the hierarchy. Crisp geometric headlines in Plus Jakarta Sans anchor each section directly without formulaic section kickers, punctuated selectively by italic Instrument Serif inflections that warm technical subject matter. Whitespace is generous, surfaces curve softly at architectural radii, and every screen funnels naturally toward a single clear invitation: booking a 30-minute conversation directly with the principal architect.

We explicitly reject generic SaaS gradient-text clichés, navy-and-gray corporate stock templates, rigid single-track boxed grids, and gratuitous motion theatrics that penalize reduced-motion visitors.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating Dual Atmosphere: Deep Velvet Night stages frame interactive proof and conversion moments; Warm Raw Silk chapters give long-form architectural substance calm reading room.
Four-Discipline Spectrum: Luminous Coral, Glacier Sky, Warm Amber, and Jade Mint map 1:1 to Applications & Web, Power BI Intelligence, System Automation, and Cloud Governance.
Editorial-Geometric Tension: Tightly tracked Plus Jakarta Sans (-0.032em to -0.036em) paired with fluid Instrument Serif italics (1.09em) for deliberate focal inflection.
Tactile Pill Ergonomics: Full-pill interactive controls (999px radius, >= 44px touch targets) contrast against generous rounded architectural cards (1.75rem to 2.5rem).

Respectful Kinetic Craft: Idle-deferred custom GLSL/WebGL sculpture and exponential ease-out choreography degrade cleanly to crisp static geometry and 180ms color/opacity feedback under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

rules.name: The Surface-Paired Accent Rule
rules.body: Luminous accents (#ff6b4a, #5ec2ff, #ffaa5c, #5eead4) appear as text only on Deep Velvet Night surfaces; on Warm Raw Silk, always switch to their paired ink tokens (#c2391a, #135d96, #964d08, #0e6f65) so body and label contrast stays comfortably above 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Solid Letterform Rule
rules.body: Never apply multi-stop CSS background-clip: text gradients to headlines or impact counters; typographic emphasis comes from solid coral or ivory contrast, scale, and italic serif form.

rules.name: The Self-Sufficient Heading Rule
rules.body: Section headings never carry a decorative eyebrow badge or uppercase kicker above them; only the hero may display an operational scope pill, leaving every subsequent <h2> to lead its chapter cleanly.

rules.name: The Single Italic Inflection Rule
rules.body: Use Instrument Serif italic at most once per heading so the contrast reads as deliberate editorial authorship rather than ornament.

rules.name: The Single-Pass Glass Rule
rules.body: Apply backdrop-filter only to top-level floating chrome (the sticky header pill, mobile menu drawer, secondary glass CTA, and standalone form shell); nested controls inside an already-framed dark container use solid translucent surface tokens (rgba(11, 12, 20, 0.72)) with 1px hairlines.

dos: Do alternate Deep Velvet Night (#0b0c14) and Warm Raw Silk (#f6f3ee) chapters so dense enterprise proof and calm architectural reading balance each other.
Do lead every case study and capability card with concrete business outcomes (1,188+ records migrated, 200+ environments governed, 1.2M customers reached) before listing stack tags.
Do enforce >= 44×44px hit targets on every interactive control, including standalone inline email and legal links.
Do keep all styling in external hashed Astro stylesheets (style-src 'self') with zero inline style="" attributes or inline event handlers.
Do gate heavy WebGL imports behind !prefers-reduced-motion and preserve 180ms non-spatial hover/focus state feedback for reduced-motion users.
donts: Don't place decorative eyebrow badges or uppercase kickers above section <h2> headings; let the headline scale and serif inflection carry the entry.
Don't use CSS background-clip: text gradients on headings, counters, or labels.
Don't auto-activate role="tab" panels on pointerenter hover; require intentional click or keyboard selection.
Don't use filter: blur(80px+) offscreen divs or nested backdrop-filter layers when a multi-stop radial-gradient or translucent token achieves the same depth at zero GPU cost.
Don't narrow the studio narrative to a single tool — always represent custom web apps, Power Apps/Pages, Power BI, Power Automate, and cloud governance as one cohesive practice.
